shortDescription: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has received a filing from Grayscale seeking to rename Litecoin Trust as the "Grayscale Litecoin Trust ETF" and list it on NYSE Arca under the ticker LTCN. According to PANews, the application aims to change the trust's name and pursue an exchange listing.
